summary: A young man attempts an orange bouldering problem on a climbing gym wall, methodically moving up before slipping near the top and dropping down safely onto the mat.

people.description: Young man with dark wavy hair wearing an oversized light blue short-sleeved shirt, grey trousers, and climbing shoes

moments.action: Climber walks up to the wall, grips the starting orange holds, and places his feet to start climbing
Climber carefully balances on tiny footholds, shifting weight while locked off on large holds
good_for: taking it one step at a time

moments.action: Climber reaches for high sloper holds near the top of the wall before losing his grip and falling to the mat
moments.emotion: determined effort followed by sudden release
